name: holographic-memory
description: Persistent cross-session memory for Claude Code using Holographic Reduced Representations (HRR). Automatically injects relevant facts into every conversation and extracts memorable moments at session end.

interface.shortDescription: Persistent cross-session memory with HRR vector search.
interface.longDescription: Stores facts in SQLite with Holographic Reduced Representations for semantic retrieval. Three hooks: SessionStart initializes the DB and reports fact count; UserPromptSubmit searches memory and injects relevant facts as context; Stop calls Claude to extract memorable facts from the session transcript. Zero runtime dependencies — uv bootstraps numpy automatically.
